test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

These include the nature/ documentaries, including/ The Blue Planet and The Planet Earth.

options.text: The Blue Planet and the Planet Earth.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the capitalization error in "**The Planet Earth**."
 
• Proper nouns such as the titles of documentaries should follow standard capitalization rules.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**The Blue Planet and Planet Earth**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"These include the nature documentaries, including **The Blue Planet and Planet Earth.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in option 2.
 
• **Option 3: "documentaries, including"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "These include the nature"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
